hypothesis.statement: The vertical-GRF push-off peak differs across the five GaitRec gait classes -- healthy control (n=208), ankle (n=483), knee (n=499), hip (n=364), calcaneus (n=290); the newly-authored kruskalTest reproduces base R stats::kruskal.test BIT-FOR-BIT and scipy.stats.kruskal to machine precision. Healthy controls have the largest push-off (highest mean rank) and calcaneus pathology the smallest (lowest mean rank).

analysis_plan.dataset: GaitRec (Horsak et al. 2020); vertical-GRF push-off peak (3rd landmark of PhysioMoCap::grfLandmarks) across the five gait classes, shod, standardised speed, initial-presentation baseline sessions

decision.threshold: descriptive: kruskalTest equals base R kruskal.test bit-for-bit (|diff| = 0) and scipy.stats.kruskal to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9); the groups differ (omnibus H, p < 0.001) with healthy controls highest-ranked and calcaneus lowest-ranked in push-off
